decisions.statement: The folder a new account is written into is read off the pages already there.
A root holding no account throws rather than guessing that folder.
A page's file is named for its slug and its page type.
An account states its id and page type and slug and provider and address and alias slot.
The rest of the values an account states is left for the upstream probe to answer.
The export a page is bound to is that page's slug with each dash dropped.
An alias slot is written as a number rather than as text.
A page composed here parses whatever characters the address carries.
Every text written into the page is written as a quoted literal is.
The page's text closes with one newline.
A page composed names its type from the root rather than by a relative path.
A name the account shape refuses is refused before anything is read.
An address with a space or naming no host is refused.
An alias slot that is no whole number from 1 up is refused.
The name is weighed before the address and the address before the alias slot.
An account a page already exists for is answered as standing rather than made.
An identity the caller names is written rather than a fresh identity.
A page is written through the landing rather than onto the disk here.
The change adding a file writes the page rather than an edit composed here.
A landing that refused says why in the words the landing refused with.
Making a page answers with an outcome rather than throwing.
A make that threw after the landing committed names that commit in what it refuses with.
The repository root reaches this module as a parameter.
The reading of the index reaches this module as a parameter.
The landing reaches this module as a parameter.
Nothing here writes a secret.
Nothing here fetches.
Nothing here prints.
An address is judged as holding one `@` between two runs of non-space.
Neither the address nor the alias slot is weighed against the accounts there are.
A new account's page is written into a folder of its own beside the other accounts' folders.

definition: making the page a new model-account is reached by
